title: Lattice finish manifest
description: A shipped finish PACKAGE (engineering/decisions/2026-09-23-portable-packages.md §3.3, §3.6). The manifest owns the name and the picker's presentation; the look lives in the sibling <name>.recipe.json. The register (lib/core/resolve-finish.js), the Studio's preset recipes and its picker catalog are all generated from these files by tools/build-packages-index.js.

name.description: The `finish:` register value. MUST equal the folder name and every file prefix (checkPackageIdentity).

blurb.description: One line under the label in the picker.

order.description: Position in the register and the picker. Unique across finishes.

swatch.description: The picker chip: a CSS background (and optional size) in accent-mix gradients only.
